summary: Add an integration test that executes the real engine `install.sh`/`forgel version --json` contract, or generate and validate the stub against that contract. Update the tests so they fail on the current contract mismatch.
requirements: The combined-install tests use `tests/stub_engine_install.py`, which encodes the same assumed `forgel-install` interface and nested engine JSON. No test runs the actual engine installer or the actual engine version report, so the release's required one-command pair and idempotent keep/replace behavior are not verified against the other repository.
acceptance: The release audit finding is resolved: The combined-install tests use `tests/stub_engine_install.py`, which encodes the same assumed `forgel-install` interface and nested engine JSON. No test runs the actual engine installer or the actual engine version report, so the release's required one-command pair and idempotent keep/replace behavior are not verified against the other repository.
plan_goal: Make Forgel and Forgel Code install and run as one working pair: give the engine `forgel` its own installer, add a mode of the Forgel Code installer that installs both binaries together (offered by default in the README, idempotent — when the engine is already present it compares versions and installs only a strictly newer one), and introduce a declared minimum supported engine version for Forgel Code, checked at startup, so a missing or too-old engine produces a clear actionable message instead of `engine forgel: executable not found: forgel`.
